title: Otter blocks plugin slows down pages if Cookies policy is activated on website
body:
This happens with multiple cookies policy plugins/features and it only depends how much a website is slowed down.
A client reported that some of his pages timeout if the Otter plugin is activated together with the GDPR cookies plugin - https://wordpress.org/plugins/cookie-law-info/

I was able to replicate the issue and even using OrbitFox plugin (Policy notice feature) the website is slowed down significantly - https://docs.themeisle.com/article/1296-policy-notice-orbit-fox-module
It doesn't timeout in my case but takes a lot to load compared to when one of these plugins is disabled.

I didn't find anything specifically added to the page that could be causing it, based on my tests it only matters how many resources are added to the page so more content and images to have - more time it takes to load with these plugins activated and ultimately it causes timeout.

Here is the network tab with both Otter and OrbitFox plugins activated (sorted by resources taking most time): https://vertis.d.pr/f79XK1

Here is the network tab with the Policy notice of OrbitFox disabled: https://vertis.d.pr/b0y5td

The website has only these 2 plugins enabled: https://vertis.d.pr/quLL09

Content of the page that could be copied to face this issue (it has a lot of content so hard to replicate with only a few images but the more content you add the slower page becomes as every resource seems to be delayed):
https://pastebin.com/nZgpjE0F

Also, here is a test instance where you can check it (valid for 7 days):
https://loseyarn.s4-tastewp.com/2022/03/07/3commas-dca-bot-indicator-strategy-v1/
